scenarios.name: Staggered traffic
scenarios.description: Two lane changes are needed. The next lane is open, but the goal-lane gap is moving faster.

scenarios.name: A slower middle lane
scenarios.description: The middle-lane leader limits acceleration. A coupled plan chooses speed with the next transition in mind.

scenarios.name: A delayed goal-lane gap
scenarios.description: A compact, slower pack occupies the goal lane. Planning an earlier speed reduction can make its rear gap reachable sooner.
